title: Recall Calibrator
user: Spaced-repetition users who distrust their own Good/Hard/Easy judgment and want to know whether they can actually retrieve an answer.
smallest_useful_product: A local review companion that samples typed exact/keyword recall before revealing an answer, compares it to the learner's grade, and reports personal calibration with exportable intervals.
success_measure: After 200 sampled reviews, at least 60% of pilot users reduce the gap between self-grade and typed-recall result by 20% or more.
constraints: Use deterministic matching and configurable accepted answers; keep answer text local; clearly label the result as a recall proxy, not a learning diagnosis.
